name: – Salvatore De Meo – § 6 – Am 9
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU agri-food promotion policy
part_text: 6. Stresses the need to use modern promotion tools based on thorough consumer demand analysis, and to support targeted communication campaigns that can add value to the promotion of EU food products in particular by highlighting their quality and origin, while contributing to the EU’s wider objectives, including the prevention of non-communicable diseases and the promotion of healthy and balanced diets; advocates the use of digital tools and new technologies, including the use of online campaigns and direct consumer access, as digitalisation can increase opportunities for small and rural producers to access markets without the high costs associated with traditional promotion channels;
